We hired a summer 2024 Science Undergraduate Laboratory Internships (SULI) program intern from the University of Missouri-Kansas City who was instrumental in building out the model and running simulations. Her summer was so successful that she was retained through the end of the project via NREL’s Research Participant Program (RPP). Milestone 1.1.3: Identify growth condition that leads to ≥100 µm/min Si deposition rate across 150 mm diameter wafer within 3D CFD model of reactor and understand the factors that control deposition rate uniformity. Obtaining a high growth rate is critical to the economic feasibility of the process. Boule growth processes operate in the range 1-3 mm/min, which is faster than we expect to be able to deposit new Si, but something in the range of 100 µm/min is theoretically feasible.
